selection: fixed AN0521 and BFBM000059 after seeing metadata QA spans, nonzero provider counts and US EPA Water Quality Portal metadata that identifies each as a river/stream; no temperature values or model errors examined
previous_contact: no exact IDs in the named source inventory or searched repository text, but aliases, binary caches and connected watersheds remain unresolved; no independence claim
data_request: provider CSV download API, temperature parameter selected, one station-year per request; source files local only; inspect headers, timestamps and availability before any reconstruction scoring
qualification: require unique full 24-hour days with documented time basis and expected provider sampling cadence, nonestimated finite measurements and interpretable quality flags; at least four complete calendar years per station and three other years for local fitting
qa_caveat: downloadable records are described as quality-assured, but this does not on its own resolve flags, clock, estimated values or sensor comparability
rights: source provider reuse and redistribution terms require clarification; keep original and station-level derivatives in local private directory
timing: post-hoc availability-based site selection after seeing public metadata and record counts; any eventual evaluation is exploratory and not preregistered population inference
